value.title: Workstream 009: docs in the pij CLI

sections.name: goal
sections.value: Any seat reads pij's documentation from the CLI, starting with the fleet's constructs.

value.title: Start page, list and get, bundled
value.done_when: With the daemon stopped, `pij agents-start-here`, `pij docs list` and `pij docs get <page>#<heading>` print from the installed binary and launch nothing.

value.title: One source, checked
value.done_when: `harness checks` fails and names a bundled page that differs from its file.

value.title: The first pages
value.done_when: The start page, concepts, one page per type, pods and building a role are listed and read.
value.note: The concepts page is skills/pij/references/community/concepts.md (blueprint 005 c-docs), written here so it has one writer. The pods page shipped after PRD 008 merged (plan 258); plan 246 shipped the rest.

value.title: Refusals and first turns point at pages
value.done_when: A refusal for a missing type names its page, and a seat's first turn names the page for its type.
value.note: The first-turn half follows req-06 as written (pm-001, 2026-11-25): the type part names the page and keeps only the role's own rule changes and the seed.

value.change: Ownership moved from pij-autonomous-parrot to pm-001 for the build.
s03 complete: the pods page (plan 258); depends on 008 s02, now on main.
